purpose: Reconstruct the historical Frankenstein memory lineage and its current migration into deterministic EntityOS database authority plus bounded Emergent Retrieval. Memory artifacts are evidence-bearing state/projections; memory is never automatically observation or world fact.
evidence_law: graph expansion != permission to invent context

lineage.surviving_function: Represent uncertain remembered claims with provenance/confidence and retrieve across multiple evidence dimensions rather than treating every stored sentence as fact.
lineage.boundary: Historical implementation existence does not establish current retrieval quality or canonical equivalence.

negative_evidence: trigger/cooldown thresholds required retuning because cycles were too rare
package/path shadowing broke LCME import until precedence was fixed
lineage.boundary: Replay may amplify bad or noncanonical memories; it cannot mint evidence through repetition.

lineage.surviving_function: Long-horizon task cognition needs durable exact project state that survives model/module restart.
lineage.boundary: A persistent task record does not prove the task is current, authorized or completed.

lineage.observed_problem: State, memory, goals, graph projections, service-local caches and effects become causally ambiguous when each can act as an independent durable truth owner.
lineage.successor_constraint: One deterministic durable authority substrate may contain many typed tables/indexes/views/journals, while graphs/workspaces remain rebuildable projections and high-rate transient sensor state may remain outside in RAM.

lineage.surviving_function: Fuse independently stored dimensions such as semantic similarity, time, provenance, causal lineage, current state, goals and effects at query time while failing closed on ambiguous/unbound resolution.
lineage.negative_evidence: Historical retrieval contamination and unconstrained graph expansion motivate strict row/provenance/epoch binding.
lineage.boundary: Source-ready cascade does not prove integrated runtime utility or superiority over simpler retrieval.

database_scope: data that must survive module restart or grid-size changes
lineage.boundary: Durable exact data should not be repeatedly reconstructed by model inference merely to persist it.

current_emergent_retrieval_hypothesis.hypothesis: Query-time fusion of independent evidence dimensions improves task-relevant retrieval/decision utility over the strongest single-axis baseline without increasing contamination or leakage.
counterhypotheses: the apparent gain comes only from a larger candidate budget
semantic similarity alone explains the gain
graph expansion increases recall while harming decision precision
current_emergent_retrieval_hypothesis.falsifier: A preregistered family-separated benchmark fails to improve relevant precision/recall/decision utility after equalizing candidate budget and leakage controls.

open_gaps: Commit-by-commit memory chronology across every Titan/LCME/Hippocampus generation remains incomplete.
Exact current database schema/version/concurrency identity must be bound before durability claims.
Dream/replay/consolidation has not been promoted into the current architecture without bounded executable benefit evidence.
